cards.title: Reviews open beside the inbox
cards.text: Click a review and it opens in a panel next to the list, which stays in view. J and K move to the next and previous review, even while you work in the view. You can switch back to the single-page view in Settings › General.
cards.alt: The inbox with a review open in a panel on its right

cards.title: See where a decision came from
cards.text: A CLI or API badge marks a decision, a discard or a withdrawal that was not made in the app, with the details on hover. The badge turns amber when the agent that asked also decided.
cards.alt: The history, with a CLI badge on a review an agent decided, and its tooltip

cards.title: Official plugins update with the app
cards.text: When Pinrail updates, the official plugins you installed move to the versions it carries the next time it starts. Reviews keep the version they were submitted to.
cards.alt: Settings, Plugins: the installed official plugins and their versions

cards.title: J and K are reserved for Pinrail
cards.text: J and K always move through the inbox, so plugins can no longer use them. The plugins that did now use N (next) and P (previous) to move between items.
cards.alt: The keyboard shortcuts of a code review, with N and P for the next and previous proposal
